title: FamCal Event Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`), screen time (`screentime:usage`).
app: Baby-tracking app exports (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, screen-time reports, and growth logs via Splunk HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=famcal:event
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by calendar_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when FamCal event data has stopped arriving for a given calendar.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per calendar and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It helps keep when one part of your FamCal event feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
